verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Figma exposes 'variables' as a concept (pulled into IDE via MCP, referenced in components docs) but the pack contains no first-party documentation of the Variables panel itself, mode/theme switching, or applying variable modes across frames — only mentions of extracting variables for code generation. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on creating/managing variable collections, defining modes (e.g., light/dark), and applying themes across designs, plus any independent confirmation of this workflow.
